language.name: Greek
language.canonical_note: Modern Greek course for canonical lang:ell across Albania, Cyprus, and Greece; Ancient Greek is not conflated with the modern language.

inventory_priority.demand_case: durable worldwide heritage, migration, tourism, education and professional demand, with official A1–C2 certification

orthography_pronunciation.voice_strategy: Synthetic el-GR browser voice with explicit provenance; Cypriot and other variation acknowledged without false native-audio claims.

register_pragmatics: standard spoken versus formal written Greek

CEFR_progression.A1: alphabet, stress, identity, agreement, basic present and everyday interaction
CEFR_progression.A2: past/future, aspect foundations, clitics, requests, directions and quantities
CEFR_progression.B1: aspect choice, να clauses, relatives, connected narration and mediation
CEFR_progression.B2: conditions, mediopassive, clitic doubling, stance and register shifts
CEFR_progression.C1: academic synthesis, nominalisation, evidence calibration and professional diplomacy
CEFR_progression.C2: scope, ambiguity, implication, rhetoric, idiom, genre transformation and stylistic precision
